description: Version lock for the sso-single-branch-development skill's external dependencies. Seeded (never clobbered) by install-hooks.sh into .github/hooks/skill-deps.json and COMMITTED so the pinned versions travel to every checkout/worktree. track-preflight.sh verifies these once per run (results TTL-cached under runs/ — see TRACK_DEPS_CACHE_TTL_HOURS) so a heavy version probe does not re-run every time.
notes: range grammar (space-separated = AND): '>=X.Y', '>X.Y', '<=X.Y', '<X.Y', '=X.Y', or a bare 'X.Y' (treated as '>=X.Y'). Tilde/caret are NOT supported — spell the bounds out, e.g. '>=2.1 <3'.
probe = the command whose output carries the version; the first N.N(.N) token in its stdout/stderr is parsed. If the probe's binary is absent from PATH the dep is 'missing'.
required:true  → a missing dep hard-fails preflight; an out-of-range version hard-fails only when TRACK_DEPS_STRICT=1 (otherwise it warns).
required:false → missing or out-of-range only ever warns; use for repo toolchain that not every run needs.
an empty range ('') skips the version check but still records presence (pure caching, no lock).
